description.en: Market day: Granny Maggie's stall with its scales and weights, her eggs and cheese and her brown hen, the vegetables and the crates, Brewer Sam's cart with his bottles of ale and apple juice, the pigeons, prices in pounds and pence, rhubarb in spring and damsons in September.
description.sl: Tržni dan: stojnica babice Maggie s tehtnico in utežmi, njena jajca in sir in njena rjava kokoš, zelenjava in zaboji, voz pivovarja Sama s steklenicami piva in jabolčnega soka, golobi, cene v funtih in penijih, spomladi rabarbara in septembra slive.
description.it: Giorno di mercato: la bancarella di nonna Maggie con la bilancia e i pesi, le sue uova, il suo formaggio e la sua gallina marrone, la verdura e le cassette, il carro di Sam il birraio con le bottiglie di birra e di succo di mela, i piccioni, i prezzi in sterline e penny, il rabarbaro in primavera e le susine a settembre.
description.de: Markttag: Oma Maggies Stand mit Waage und Gewichten, ihre Eier, ihr Käse und ihr braunes Huhn, das Gemüse und die Kisten, Brauer Sams Wagen mit Flaschen voll Ale und Apfelsaft, die Tauben, Preise in Pfund und Pence, Rhabarber im Frühling und Pflaumen im September.

words.example_en: Granny Maggie sells eggs at her stall.
words.example_sl: Babica Maggie na svoji stojnici prodaja jajca.
words.example_it: Nonna Maggie vende uova alla sua bancarella.
words.example_de: Oma Maggie verkauft an ihrem Stand Eier.
words.note: A market stall; the stallholder stands behind it and sells.
words.note_sl: Market stall: tržna stojnica; stallholder stoji za njo in prodaja.
words.note_it: Market stall: la bancarella del mercato; lo stallholder ci sta dietro e vende.
words.note_de: Market stall: der Marktstand; der stallholder steht dahinter und verkauft.

words.example_en: Put the cheese on the scales.
words.example_de: Leg den Käse auf die Waage.
words.note: In Britain scales is plural: the scales are here.
words.note_sl: V Britaniji je scales v množini: the scales are here (tehtnica je tukaj).
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna scales è plurale: the scales are here (la bilancia è qui).
words.note_de: Im Britischen ist scales Plural: the scales are here (die Waage ist hier).

words.example_en: Maggie puts a weight on the scales.
words.example_it: Maggie mette un peso sulla bilancia.
words.example_de: Maggie legt ein Gewicht auf die Waage.
words.note: The gh is silent: say WAIT. Maggie's old weights are in pounds and ounces.
words.note_sl: Gh je nem: izgovori »vejt«. Maggiejine stare uteži so v funtih in uncah.
words.note_it: Il gh è muto: si dice «ueit». I vecchi pesi di Maggie sono in libbre e once.
words.note_de: Das gh ist stumm: man sagt »weit«. Maggies alte Gewichte sind in Pfund und Unzen.

words.note: One vegetable, a lot of vegetables. People often just say veg: fruit and veg.
words.note_sl: One vegetable, a lot of vegetables. Pogosto rečejo kar veg: fruit and veg (sadje in zelenjava).
words.note_it: One vegetable, a lot of vegetables. Spesso si dice solo veg: fruit and veg (frutta e verdura).
words.note_de: One vegetable, a lot of vegetables. Oft sagt man einfach veg: fruit and veg (Obst und Gemüse).

words.example_it: Una cassetta di mele, per favore.
words.note: A wooden box for fruit, vegetables or bottles.
words.note_sl: Lesen zaboj za sadje, zelenjavo ali steklenice.
words.note_it: Una cassetta di legno per la frutta, la verdura o le bottiglie.
words.note_de: Eine Holzkiste für Obst, Gemüse oder Flaschen.

words.example_en: Maggie's brown hen lays an egg every day.
words.example_sl: Maggiejina rjava kokoš vsak dan znese jajce.
words.example_it: La gallina marrone di Maggie fa un uovo ogni giorno.
words.example_de: Maggies braunes Huhn legt jeden Tag ein Ei.
words.note: A hen is the mother chicken; a cock, or cockerel, is the father.
words.note_sl: Hen je kokoš; petelin je cock ali cockerel.
words.note_it: Hen è la gallina; il gallo è cock o cockerel.
words.note_de: Hen ist die Henne; der Hahn heißt cock oder cockerel.

words.example_en: Sam has a crate of brown bottles on his cart.
words.example_sl: Sam ima na vozu zaboj rjavih steklenic.
words.example_it: Sam ha sul carro una cassetta di bottiglie marroni.
words.example_de: Sam hat eine Kiste brauner Flaschen auf seinem Wagen.
words.note: A bottle of ale, a bottle of juice: what is in it comes after of.
words.note_sl: A bottle of ale (steklenica piva), a bottle of juice (steklenica soka): vsebina pride za of.
words.note_it: A bottle of ale (una bottiglia di birra), a bottle of juice (una bottiglia di succo): il contenuto viene dopo of.
words.note_de: A bottle of ale (eine Flasche Ale), a bottle of juice (eine Flasche Saft): der Inhalt kommt nach of.

words.example_en: The pigeons fly up off the street.
words.example_it: I piccioni si alzano in volo dalla strada.
words.example_de: Die Tauben fliegen von der Straße auf.
words.note: Say PIDGE-in. A white one is a dove.
words.note_it: Si pronuncia «pigin». Una colomba bianca è una dove.
words.note_de: Man sagt »pidschin«. Eine weiße Taube ist eine dove.

words.note: £1 = one pound = a hundred pence. People also say quid: five quid.
words.note_sl: £1 = one pound (en funt) = sto penijev. Rečejo tudi quid: five quid (pet funtov).
words.note_it: £1 = one pound (una sterlina) = cento penny. Si dice anche quid: five quid (cinque sterline).
words.note_de: £1 = one pound (ein Pfund) = hundert Pence. Man sagt auch quid: five quid (fünf Pfund).

words.note: One penny, two pence: for money the plural is pence. People often say fifty p.
words.note_sl: One penny, two pence: pri denarju je množina pence. Pogosto rečejo kar fifty p (petdeset penijev).
words.note_it: One penny, two pence: per i soldi il plurale è pence. Spesso si dice fifty p (cinquanta penny).
words.note_de: One penny, two pence: beim Geld heißt der Plural pence. Oft sagt man einfach fifty p (fünfzig Pence).

words.example_en: Rhubarb crumble is the taste of spring.
words.example_it: Il crumble di rabarbaro è il sapore della primavera.
words.note: The h is silent: ROO-barb. Red sticks, very sour; with sugar in a crumble, wonderful.
words.note_sl: H je nem: »rubarb«. Rdeča stebla, zelo kisla; s sladkorjem v crumblu čudovita.
words.note_it: La h è muta: «rubarb». Gambi rossi, molto aspri; con lo zucchero in un crumble, meravigliosi.
words.note_de: Das h ist stumm: »ruubarb«. Rote Stangen, sehr sauer; mit Zucker im Crumble wunderbar.

words.example_en: In September Sam picks the damsons.
words.example_it: A settembre Sam raccoglie le susine.
words.example_de: Im September pflückt Sam die Pflaumen.
words.note: Damsons are small dark purple plums, sour until they're cooked. The Lyth Valley near Kendal is famous for them.
words.note_sl: Damsons so majhne temno vijolične slive, kisle, dokler jih ne skuhaš. Po njih slovi dolina Lyth pri Kendalu.
words.note_it: Le damson sono piccole susine viola scuro, aspre finché non si cuociono. La valle di Lyth vicino a Kendal è famosa per queste.
words.note_de: Damsons sind kleine dunkelviolette Pflaumen, sauer, bis man sie kocht. Das Lyth Valley bei Kendal ist berühmt dafür.

words.example_en: Sam's ale is for the grown-ups.
words.example_it: La birra di Sam è per i grandi.
words.example_de: Sams Ale ist für die Erwachsenen.
words.note: Ale is an old English beer, brown and not very cold. A pint of ale, please!
words.note_sl: Ale je staro angleško pivo, rjavo in ne preveč hladno. A pint of ale, please! (Vrček piva, prosim!)
words.note_it: L'ale è una vecchia birra inglese, scura e non troppo fredda. A pint of ale, please! (Una pinta di ale, per favore!)
words.note_de: Ale ist ein altes englisches Bier, braun und nicht sehr kalt. A pint of ale, please! (Ein Pint Ale, bitte!)

words.example_en: A glass of apple juice, please.
words.example_it: Un bicchiere di succo di mela, per favore.
words.note: Ui sounds like oo: JOOS. Apple juice, damson juice.
words.note_sl: Ui se izgovori kot u: »džus«. Apple juice: jabolčni sok.
words.note_it: Ui si pronuncia come u: «giuus». Apple juice: succo di mela.
words.note_de: Ui klingt wie u: »dschuus«. Apple juice: Apfelsaft.
